forgot.title: Forgotten password
forgot.text: Enter your account's e-mail address: you will get a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses this address, an e-mail is on its way. The link stays valid for 30 minutes.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Your password is changed. For your safety, you are signed out of every device and every app.
reset.invalid: This link no longer works. Ask for a new one.

account.appsText: This account signs you in to each of them.
account.languageHint: Used for e-mails and by the apps that offer it.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices are signed out.
account.sessionsText: Signing out here signs you out of every app on this device.
account.deleteText: Your account and what each app keeps about you will be erased. This cannot be undone.

signedOut.title: You are signed out
signedOut.text: You are signed out of every Synapse app on this device.
signedOut.deletedText: Your account is erased, and each app was told to erase what it kept about you.

service.title: The service
service.text: The Synapse account signs you in, with one login, to the apps of Synapse Engineering (a Belgian company), such as Plano and Erudi. Each app has its own terms for what it does with your data; this text covers the account itself.

account.title: Your account
account.text: You must be 13 or older. You keep your password secret and are responsible for what is done with your account. The service is free and provided as is; it may change or stop, and we may close an account used to harm other people or the service.

data.title: The data kept
data.text: Your first and last name, username, e-mail address, language, the date you accepted these terms, and your password, kept only in hashed form (scrypt): nobody can read it back. They are used to sign you in and are passed to the apps you open (identifier, name, username, e-mail address, language). Your IP address is not stored with your account: it is only used, in memory and for one minute, to limit password guesses.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: Only the cookies that are needed: your session's, which lasts 30 days at most, those that follow a sign-in in progress (one hour at most) and the one protecting the sign-in to this page (10 minutes). No trackers, no advertising, no third-party service: nothing is loaded from another site.

security.title: Security
security.text: A password reset link stays valid for 30 minutes and works once; using it signs you out everywhere. Repeated sign-in attempts are limited.

hosting.title: Hosting and backups
hosting.text: The data is hosted in France by OVHcloud. A backup is made every night and kept 14 days at most.

deletion.title: Deleting your account
deletion.text: From the "My account" page, with your password. The account is erased at once, all your sessions end, and each app is told to erase what it keeps about you. Backups are gone at most 14 days later.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can view, correct, export or erase your data, and object to its processing, by writing to {{email}}. You can also complain to the Belgian Data Protection Authority.

law.title: Governing law
law.text: These terms are governed by Belgian law; the courts of Brussels have jurisdiction. Any significant change will be announced before it applies.
